title: Independent verifier selection
canonical_definition: Prevent worker-selected friendly verifiers and preserve conflict-of-interest controls.

roadmap_order.note: CMP-1.4.4 remains open on current main. CMP-1.4.5 is implemented as an independently testable selection authority slice without claiming CMP-1.4.4 completion or full sequential CMP-1.4 completion.

milestone_relationship.rationale: CMP-1.4.5 adds a new selector contract without changing the shared JobRegistry or policy ABI. Level 1 includes real cross-component integration with job, policy, verifier lifecycle and verifier capability. Broader app integration is most meaningful when selection feeds replicated/N-of-M verification.

implementation.selection_rule: Only the separately designated selection authority may select, and it cannot be the canonical owner, payer, matched operator, or selected verifier.
implementation.eligibility_rule: Candidate must be the exact current ACTIVE verifier revision and already qualified as INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER for the job's exact workload class.
implementation.timing_rule: Selection occurs only while the job is ACCEPTED, after exact verification-policy binding, and before worker execution begins.
implementation.conflict_rule: ComputeVerifierIndependencePolicy420 independently revalidates current controller attestations and rejects shared-controller conflicts.
implementation.history_rule: Selection and revocation are versioned; historical selection records are not rewritten.

authority_boundaries: The selector cannot register, activate, suspend, rotate or retire verifier identities.
The selector cannot grant or revoke verifier class/workload capability.
The selector cannot publish or approve verification policies or profiles.
The identity attestor cannot appoint because only the policy-designated selector contract may call appointment.
The worker/operator, owner, payer, selected verifier and outsiders cannot invoke selection authority.

Selection is appointment evidence only and does not prove correctness, submit a verdict, move funds, choose settlement beneficiary, mutate worker lifecycle, stake/slash, govern, bridge, validate, or control wallets.
Policy authority rotation immediately invalidates the old selector contract for new appointments.
exit_criteria: A separately designated selector contract is the only path that can create new independent-verifier appointments in the qualified configuration.
Worker/operator, owner, payer, verifier and unrelated callers cannot choose the verifier.
The candidate verifier must be ACTIVE at the exact verifier revision and hold exact INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER capability for the job workload.
Current owner, payer, operator and verifier controller attestations must remain conflict-free under the independence policy.
Selection is bound to the exact job revision, workload, verification policy, verifier identity/revision, profile, evidence, expiry and selector domain.
Selection occurs before worker execution and cannot be added after the job enters RUNNING.
Revocation and replacement are versioned without rewriting historical selection evidence.
The selector grants no unrelated authority.
Level 1 exact-head Compute qualification is green.
